notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
Well it's been a while since I've updated here! I tend to post my updates on other social channels while working on the game. But I have since updated the demo! Horray!

Updates
- Sprite and dialogue tweaks
- New menu for costumes
- Updates blocking door for boss battle 

As always report any bugs please! Still slated for a Q1 2025 release

notes.title: Demo 1.1.1
notes.content:
So lets end the year on a good note. It's amazing to me how a small change can affect something else. Test, test, and TEST some more! Yay regressions!

Shoutout to [url=https://game-wisdom.com/]Game Wisdom[/url] for letting me know!

Bugfixes:
- Equipping the heart trinket caused an exception

Chores:
- Added version to title screen

Please let me know feedback if you can!

- hrok

notes.title: Territorial Hissing Demo it out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are happy to showcase the alpha build showcasing what Territorial Hissing has to offer!

Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land. Save your home in this comedy adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456632/da4520e64331104ce26a54f9353d02da14e314ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456632/3351494a4545fe2b9e195618f9bdec6b226a64af.png[/img]

It is a short slice of the beginning of the game but will show the feel and gameplay, and of course the humor.

Both keyboard and controller work for the demo.

And if you have any feedback or run into any bugs, please let us know by telling us in the forums or feel free to [url=mailto:hrokgames@gmail.com]email[/url]!
